openClinicalQuestions: Dr. Charmi: confirm preferred patient-facing list for early-pregnancy back/pelvic pain with bleeding versus later-pregnancy labour-related back pain wording for Indian readers.

claimLedger.claim: Lifting with bent knees/straight back; avoid heavy loads; flat shoes; supported sitting; rest; urgent contact for fever/bleeding/painful peeing/side pain; emergency for loss of feeling in legs/bum/genitals.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Back pain in pregnancy · Page last reviewed 10 January 2024
claimLedger.limitations: UK advice; paracetamol note is UK OTC guidance—confirm locally

claimLedger.claim: Pillow between legs in bed; supportive shoes; keep active but avoid aggravating tasks; physio may suggest support belt.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Pelvic pain in pregnancy · Page last reviewed 12 December 2022

claimLedger.claim: Side-lying preferred; pillow between legs; support bump.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS Best Start in Life · Week 27 — best sleeping positions during pregnancy · not stated on fetched page
claimLedger.limitations: General pregnancy sleep tips; stillbirth risk wording relates to later pregnancy back-sleeping research
